title: Guild JSON-RPC envelope
description: The line-delimited JSON-RPC 2.0 envelope between the desktop UI and the engine, and over the local CLI socket. Derived from crates/protocol/src/rpc.rs, which is what the wire actually is. Every message carries `protocol` so the UI and the engine can negotiate. `additionalProperties: false` is deliberate: a new field is a contract change, not a client surprise. The root is an index of the definitions: validate a payload against a `$defs` entry, never against the root.

Json.description: Any JSON value. serde_json::Value in Rust, Json in TypeScript.

Request.description: A request from client to server. Either side can be the client.

id.description: A JSON number, not a bigint. u64 in Rust.

RpcError.description: The error arm of a Response.

code.description: A JSON number. i64 in Rust; the base is -32000.

Response.description: A reply to a Request. Exactly one of result and error is present.

Event.description: An unsolicited server push: streaming deltas and status.
